items.information: This competition is a special competition with **only quiet events** that takes place on a **Thursday evening**. Only one guest per competitor is permitted. items.information: This competition is on a **Thursday evening** and will only feature blindfolded events. This competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited. In honor of Leap Day, a special prize will be given out during the awards ceremony.

items.name: Leap Day FMC in Italy & Ticino 2024
items.information: ![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/YSp2SyW.png) This competition will take place in Milan (2 venues), Bologna, Rome and Mendrisio (CH) simultaneously. Competitors *MUST* specify in the comments of the registration the city they wish to compete in. Please note that the **ONLY** event at this competitions is **3x3x3 Fewest Moves**. Competitors should be seated and ready to start the attempts at the scheduled start times. ![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png) Questa competizione si svolgerà a Milano (2 sedi), Bologna, Roma e Mendrisio (CH) in contemporanea. I partecipanti *DEVONO* specificare la città in cui desiderano partecipare nei commenti al momento della registrazione **L'UNICO** evento di questa competizione è il **3x3x3 Fewest Moves**. I partecipanti dovranno essere seduti e pronti a cominciare i tentativi agli orari prestabiliti.

items.information: Varmt välkomna till den andra deltävlingen i vårsäsongen av Uppsalaligan 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Mer information om Uppsalaligans upplägg finns under fliken med samma namn. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. -- A warm welcome to the second competition in the spring season of Uppsalaligan 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. More information about the league's structure can be found under the tab with the same name. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information.

items.name: WCC FMC Leap Day 2024
items.information: ![West Coast Cubing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc29SIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e561d0a9c0d6249576e169bfde3e7dbcbf20fe23/wcc-banner.png) - This competition is in partnership with [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) - This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves; we will not be holding any other event. - This competition will take place at different venues across California and Reno. If you are potentially unable to reach these locales, we would highly recommend refraining from registering from this competition. - Check out the Location Tab for more details.
